name: API-Football (API-Sports)
tagline: Largest football/soccer coverage: live scores, fixtures, odds, and standings
description: API-Football by API-Sports provides comprehensive football (soccer) data including live scores, fixtures, lineups, standings, odds, players, and more. Accessible via RapidAPI or direct API-Sports endpoints with broad league and competition coverage worldwide.

auth.details: API key via x-apisports-key header (direct) or X-RapidAPI-Key + X-RapidAPI-Host (RapidAPI). Self-serve signup at dashboard.api-football.com or RapidAPI.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available (limits verified from official pricing — see research notes)

use_cases: get live scores for a football match
list today's fixtures by league or date
get match odds and betting markets
look up player stats and squads
